Hi all — welcome, Samir. A few practical notes to unblock HelioSoft's activation: 

1) Data residency: For a standard marketplace listing we don't require a separate residency affidavit beyond the vendor packet if your hosted endpoints process EU data in an EU region. Since you stated Frankfurt processing for EU customers, please include the cloud region details in the packet (we've captured that in the attached Marketplace_Vendor_Packet_v3.pdf). For regulated buyers we sometimes collect a short data flow diagram; if you expect regulated customers we can ask for that later.

2) PO & invoicing options: Redwood supports two flows for marketplace sellers — (A) consolidated monthly billing to Redwood Inference, US entity (standard for most listings), or (B) direct pass-through invoicing controlled by the seller for regional VAT reasons. If HelioSoft needs direct invoicing (option B) we require: seller remit-to details, VAT registration evidence, and a signed pass-through addendum.

3) Next steps: please complete the attached Marketplace_Vendor_Packet_v3.pdf and return to procurement@redwood.com. Once received, Finance will verify VAT docs and provide either (i) the DocuSign onboarding agreement + vendor W-8/W-9 equivalent, or (ii) the pass-through addendum if you want seller-side invoicing.

I've attached the packet and added the DocuSign placeholder in the related links. For timeline, we typically need 5–7 business days after complete packet + tax evidence to fully activate.

- Vanessa Ortiz
Marketplace Activation Lead
Redwood Inference

Hi Marta — thanks for the packet and VAT doc. A few items from Finance/legal to expedite the pass-through path: 

- Please provide the seller remit-to legal name exactly as registered and the VAT number (you provided GB123456789 which we will validate).
- Bank confirmation: a SWIFT/IBAN statement is sufficient (PDF). No need for a voided check for non-US banks.
- We'll also need a signed pass-through addendum (we will send via DocuSign once bank info and VAT are validated).

Invoice/PO template: if HelioSoft prefers buyer-issued POs to Redwood (we will accept) please use the following remit-to when you sign the addendum: 

  Redwood Inference, Inc.
  1201 Market St, Suite 400
  San Francisco, CA 94103
  Tax ID: 45-6789012

If you elect seller-side invoices (HelioSoft invoices buyers directly), we will attach the pass-through addendum to the listing and set the marketplace listing to pass-through billing. Either way, please upload the bank confirmation and the exact legal entity name to the HubSpot file link above.

I'll queue the DocuSign addendum once bank + VAT validated. Expect 2–3 business days for legal review.

Thanks,
